players.product: DCI transport and optical amplifier modules (800G CFP2) and datacom transceivers; silicon-waveguide optical circuit switch (OCS) at sample stage

quarterly_data.quarter: Wuxi Taclink Optoelectronics results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman and general manager Qu Jianping (H1 2026 results briefing): H1 operations were in line with expectations and orders on hand for H2 are good; as new capacity is released gradually the company expects full-year revenue to be weighted to the second half and it will strive to meet its full-year operating targets. He is positive on the optical-communication industry for H2 2026 and 2027 and said AI-compute-driven demand for optical interconnect and data-center interconnect gives the company's products mid-to-long-term support; R&D on high-speed modules and DCI subsystems stays at about 10% of revenue.

quarterly_data.quarter: Wuxi Taclink Optoelectronics results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Director, board secretary and CFO Zhang Shao (H1 2026 results briefing): H1 2026 operating cash flow fell 696.60% YoY mainly on higher raw-material payments - the company raised prepayment ratios and locked core supply resources in advance as industry supply stays tight, and raw-material needs rose with the Thailand base and domestic capacity expansion; the CFO called it a strategic resource reserve for concentrated volume production later and said cash on hand is ample. The fair-value gain on other non-current financial assets that lifted H1 net profit was RMB 7,977.98 ten-thousand, mainly from the company's participation in IPO strategic placements measured at fair value.
quarterly_data.figure: operating cash flow -696.60% YoY; fair-value gain RMB 7,977.98 ten-thousand

quarterly_data.quarter: Wuxi Taclink Optoelectronics results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company (H1 2026 results briefing, pre-collected answers): it runs EML, silicon photonics and thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN) routes in parallel and says it is one of few makers with all three; TFLN is already used in its 800G and 1.6T optical modules, which it says have clear power and performance advantages over competing solutions, and TFLN plus its silicon-photonics design platform form the basis for 3.2T and faster products. In silicon-photonics chips it does chip design and packaging, with chip manufacturing outsourced to foundries. Its 1.6T optical modules are still in customer validation, with supply timing to depend on validation progress and market demand.

quarterly_data.quarter: Wuxi Taclink Optoelectronics results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company (H1 2026 results briefing, pre-collected answer): its 64x64-port OCS has completed sample development and customer sampling and validation are being actively pushed.
